listSubtitle: Manage encrypted credential vaults for sessions.
listDeleteVaultMessage: Are you sure you want to permanently delete "{{name}}"? This will also delete all its credentials.
listArchiveVaultMessage: Are you sure you want to archive "{{name}}"? Encrypted secrets will be purged.
detailKekHint: A customer-managed Fernet key-encryption-key used for event encryption (x-kek-credential-id on session creation).
detailApiKeyHint: This key is used for LLM calls to the selected provider: it is matched and injected at runtime only when this vault is selected during session creation (otherwise the session fails with a missing-credential error unless an environment variable is set).
detailReplaceHint: Provided values replace all stored secrets for this credential.
detailProvideSecret: Provide at least one secret value.
detailDeleteCredMessage: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this credential?
detailArchiveCredMessage: Are you sure you want to archive this credential? Encrypted secrets will be purged.
